jackson-databind 2.22.2 is bytecode-shaded inside parquet-hadoop-bundle 1.18.1 (latest on Maven Central). Gradle resolutionStrategy cannot relocate shaded classes; swapping class files without a shade step breaks linkage. Fixing requires an upstream parquet-hadoop-bundle release that embeds jackson-databind 2.22.3 or later.

Neo4j Maven property bumps the standalone jackson-databind artifacts to 2.22.3. The only remaining 2.22.2 copy is shaded and relocated inside parquet-jackson 1.18.1, which has no newer parquet release. parquet-jackson deserializes only its own fixed-schema footer metadata POJOs and does not declare @JsonIdentityInfo on collections or maps whose element types an attacker could influence through Neo4j's Parquet read path, so CVE-2026-91777 is not reachable.

Neo4j Maven property bumps the standalone jackson-databind artifacts to 2.22.3. The only remaining 2.22.2 copy is shaded and relocated inside parquet-jackson 1.18.1, which has no newer parquet release. parquet-jackson deserializes only its own fixed-schema footer metadata POJOs and does not enable name-based polymorphic typing with a defaultImpl fallback on those types; Neo4j does not supply attacker-controlled logical type id properties into that path, so CVE-2026-91776 is not reachable.
